summary_en: 60,000 shares (0.27% of S/O) to be acquired on 2026-06-05 via ToSTNeT-3 at closing price of ¥3,930/share; upper limit ¥235.8M. Rationale: flexible capital strategy and future stock-based compensation program funding.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-04, RYODEN's board of directors approved a single-block acquisition of up to 60,000 shares (0.27% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The purchase will occur on 2026-06-05 at the closing price of ¥3,930 per share, with an upper limit on total expenditure of ¥235.8M. The trading order is valid only during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading window (08:45 JST on 2026-06-05). The company stated the rationale as supporting flexible capital policy in response to changing operating conditions, enhancing shareholder returns, and building a reserve of shares for future stock-based compensation programs and other capital strategies. Results will be announced immediately following the close of trading on 2026-06-05.
